title: Raku Firing
host_org: Earth & Fire Pottery Classes and Gallery
source_quote: Occasionally, Earth & Fire potters will schedule a raku firing.
evidence_sentence: The page describes how raku firings work: pottery is removed from the kiln at bright red heat and subjected to post-firing reduction in combustible materials.
evidence_quote: In Raku, pottery is removed from the kiln at bright red heat and subjected to post-firing reduction (or smoking) by being placed in containers of combustible materials, which blackens raw clay and causes crazing in the glaze surface.
summary: Earth & Fire occasionally schedules group raku firings; contact them at (504) 234-1080 or email to find out when the next firing is scheduled.
how_to_join: Email or call (504) 234-1080 to find out when our next Raku firing is scheduled.
